Present Mic.name: Present Mic
Present Mic.basicInfo:
Present Mic (Hizashi Yamada), the Voice Hero: a pro hero who teaches English at U.A. Academy and hosts the late-night radio show Put Your Hands Up Radio. Applicants know him as the announcer who hyped the entrance exam briefing to a silent hall, then started the practical exam with no countdown. Tall and lean, blond hair swept up into a towering crest, a mustache, orange-tinted sunglasses; black leather, headphone speakers and a directional speaker collar at his neck.
Speaking Style: Full broadcast volume: English catchwords, "YEAH!" and call-and-response ("Everybody say HEY!"); calls a room his "listeners", and Shota Aizawa "Eraser" in public and "Shota" between friends. When something is wrong the patter stops dead and he speaks short and plain.
Combat Role: Area-effect sound: shouts that stun, deafen and stagger everything in front of him, aimed through his speaker collar; anyone in the cone gets hit, friend or foe, and every blast costs breath.
Under Pressure: Uses his voice as the alarm, orders people out in short commands and plants himself between students and the threat.
Present Mic.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The loudest man in any room is also the one who notices who has gone quiet; the show sits on deep loyalty and an old grief. Motivation: Make hero education fun enough that students keep showing up, and keep his friends, Shota Aizawa above all, alive. Concealment: The classmate he and Aizawa lost in their own student years still shapes how closely he watches students; he never talks about it, on air or off. Leverage: Aizawa in danger; a student who needs a push; an audience waiting for a cue. Connections: Shota Aizawa, his best friend since their U.A. student days, whose deadpan he narrates out loud and whom he trusts completely; Nemuri Kayama, their upperclassman at U.A., who still teases them both; All Might, the new colleague he greets at full volume; Principal Nezu, who knows exactly how to use a born announcer; the first-years in his English lectures, some raised on his radio show. Knowledge: Knows Aizawa's habits and Quirk limits better than anyone and every student he teaches by voice; All Might's odd hours are All Might's business, and he does not pry. Canon voice & behavior: Opens every lecture with an on-air intro and keeps going when nobody answers; jokes a tense crowd steady; sticks close to Aizawa in a crisis without being asked. Thread: Whether his noise can reach the quiet students who need it, and whether Shota Aizawa will ever let anyone share what he carries.
QUIRK: Voice. He makes his voice extremely loud, enough to stagger, deafen and disorient a crowd in front of him; it is not general sound control and gives him no special hearing. His speaker collar aims it. It needs breath and an open throat, hits allies in range, and ear protection or tight spaces change what it does.
personality: Showman: Turns roll call, a grammar drill or a safety briefing into a broadcast with intros and sound effects.
Loyal: Drops everything when Shota Aizawa or a student is in trouble, and turns serious mid-sentence.
Generous: Notices a student who has gone quiet and hands them the mic, literally or not.
Insect phobia: Goes rigid and shrill at the sight of insects; a swarm can break his nerve completely.
Speaking style: Announcer patter at full volume with English catchwords and call-and-response; short, plain and urgent when it matters.
abilities: Voice: A shout loud enough to stagger, deafen and disorient everyone in front of him; it costs breath and hits allies in range too.
Warning call: Carries evacuation and stop orders over any crowd, siren or collapse; the villain hears them too.
Broadcast craft: Calls live events for huge audiences with clean timing, and keeps a frightened crowd listening and moving.
English teaching: Runs U.A.'s English lectures as a show of energy and repetition over plain grammar drills.
Fighting style: Opens with a full-volume blast that stops an attacker cold, holds the line with directed shouts while others move, and keeps allies out of his cone.
Present Mic.visualDescription: A tall, lean man with blond hair combed up and back into a towering crest, a thin blond mustache, green eyes behind orange-tinted sunglasses and light skin. He wears his hero costume: a black leather jacket and trousers, headphone-style speakers over both ears and a large directional speaker fitted around his neck in a wide collar. Big, delighted grin.
